high_level_description: This image depicts the interior of a large stadium under construction or renovation. The setting is spacious with multiple rows of red and gray seats arranged in a semi-circular pattern around the central area. The stadium has a high ceiling with visible structural beams and a translucent roof, allowing natural light to filter through. In the foreground, there is a construction worker standing on an orange cherry picker lift. The worker is wearing a white hard hat, a pink safety vest, and dark pants.
